catalyst.mmr.tooltip.miner.item:
Using stone, deepslate, netherrack, end stone, sand, calcite, kivi or blackslag as input will generate a random amount of ores.
Alternatively, use an empty bucket to generate fluids.
Some ores have dimension restrictions, but everything works in the Mining Dimension.
Water, Liquid Darkness and Phyto Oil increase resource output (in that order).
While active, it produces random junk, 2 types of fluids and some items.
